action: Students: do not share or reproduce the circulating file, as UFLA advises, and follow UFLA's official channels for updates.
date_note: Date is the Itatiaia article's publication day; the g1 article's address is dated 20 November but was not read.
exec: A Brazilian federal university is investigating the release of student academic data; it says this is separate from its system outage.
plain: The Federal University of Lavras says it is investigating the release of a listing of student academic data. It says this is separate from the outage of its institutional systems.
summary: Rádio Itatiaia reports that UFLA is investigating the release of a listing of student academic data, including names, courses and academic performance coefficients. The university says the release is not linked to the unavailability of its institutional systems, which its IT directorate attributes to datacenter equipment failures, not to a cyberattack. The article gives no number of affected students.
title: UFLA investigates release of students' academic data, separate from system outage

validation.note: Only Rádio Itatiaia's page was read; the g1 page could not be fetched by the reader. UFLA's statement is as relayed by Itatiaia; the university's own page was not read.
